Kilburn Pedals

London, United Kingdom · Kilburn · Social

Beginner friendly

Kilburn Pedals is a social group ride in London, United Kingdom. It rolls third Saturday of the month at 10:00 am local time from Netherwood Youth and Family Hub. About 8 km (5 miles), gentle, with pauses and a halfway refreshment stop.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 10:00 am. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace: gentle, with pauses and a halfway refreshment stop.
Check
Look at the host's website the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Kilburn Pedals group ride

A gentle ride for people getting back on a bike or just learning: an easy 5 to 6 mile loop around the local area with pauses and a refreshment stop halfway, about two hours. If you can pedal, steer and brake, you are welcome. It is the sister ride of Kentish Town Pedals.
